statement.notes: Extracted from the primary consolidated income statement. 'total_operating_cost' includes 'Cost of revenues', 'Selling and marketing expenses', and 'General and administrative expenses' as they are the primary operating expense categories. 'Other gains/(losses), net' and 'Share of profit/(loss) of associates and joint ventures, net' are not included in total_operating_cost as they are non-operating items. 'Interest expenses' is mapped from 'Finance costs'. All values are in RMB millions. Parentheses in the source indicate negatives, converted to negative numbers.
